summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2X Long WYFI ETF (WYFL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. WFYL seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movement of WhiteFiber, Inc. (Ticker: WFYI), less fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements. WYFL was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
